source: 七房参考图可见的水体、悬浮微粒、鱼群及固定灯光；不可从静图推断的周期、声音为本次可逆设计参数
integration: new(), host=main, scenery.add_child(node); name=EnvironmentMotion. Do not also call event_effect for host.events or effects will duplicate.
reference_policy: 固定参考截图禁用补充动态；烘焙气泡、光束和小鱼仍是原图表现，不宣称已将每个烘焙像素独立化。新增粒子低密度，避免重复加亮。

elements.motion: 11–24 source px/s upward, deterministic seeded phase, x sway 7 px
elements.audio: not_applicable: subsumed into room water ambience
elements.lifecycle: room-seeded reset; wraps within visible cavity; pause/reference freezes; unload removes parent

elements.audio: not_applicable: microscopic visual particles are inaudible

elements.rule: Rooms01/02/03/04/07:7;rooms05/06:0 because their source images contain no fish
elements.motion: 5–9 px/s lateral, 7 px vertical swim; silhouette 0.55–1.1 scale
elements.lifecycle: room-seeded wrap; far layer only; no reward or persistence

elements.motion: gradient texture soft mist, max alpha0.027; x38/y6 px drift
elements.lifecycle: deterministic phases reset each room; middle depth

elements.rule: Only source-fixed lamp centers: room01 one,03 two,04 one,06 one,07 one;02/05 none
elements.motion: smooth warm pulse, two sine frequencies, no random flicker
elements.interaction: lighting shares camp art, interaction remains host checkpoint system
elements.lifecycle: reset per room; no saved light phase

elements.rule: max16 pulses,9 sparks per active pulse; trigger enemy_hit/enemy_defeated/player_death/reward/checkpoint/ability_unlocked from host event IDs
elements.motion: 0.45s hit or0.8–0.85s reward/death; lifespan then deleted
elements.physics: not_applicable: damage belongs to authoritative gameplay system
elements.audio: host.sfx already plays source event sound; no duplicated sound
elements.lifecycle: temporary only; no persistence; clears on room load

audio.fade_out: release_ambience reparent to persistent host;0.25s to -80dB thenstop/stream-null/free
audio.origin: designed low water drone; original generated waveform without external source
audio.mute: Master bus M toggle inherited from host

elements.lifecycle: loop per room, stream_paused with pause/reference; release before room change; immediate stop at application graceful quit

design_exclusions: No literal water surface or splash plane added: reference represents submerged cavities, not a visible horizontal waterline.
No second full-screen light shaft: source shaft direction and colors retained.
Canopy/rope geometry and membrane deformation remain parent scene responsibilities; this script does not fake them with particles.
